metadata.title: Palantir Heads for Worst Day in 7 Months. It Isn’t the Only Software Stock Sinking.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Palantir Heads for Worst Day in 7 Months. It Isn’t the Only Software Stock Sinking.
Palantir Technologies was pacing toward its worst day in seven months on Wednesday in the absence of any appreciable news. It was far from the only software stock taking a beating.
